title: Aka Manto: Red or Blue?

characters.name: Aka Manto
characters.look: a tall figure in a long crimson hooded cloak and a smooth pale mask, face hidden

characters.name: the student
characters.look: a young woman of about twenty in a dark school blazer, short black hair

locations.name: Old School Restroom
locations.look: an old school restroom with pale green tiles, a row of wooden stall doors and one flickering fluorescent tube

red: covered in blood; blue: drained of blood

scenes.narration: Imagine being alone in a bathroom when someone whispers from the next stall, “Red or blue?”
scenes.image_prompt: the student alone at a sink in a dim tiled restroom, frozen, looking toward the closed stall beside her, rule of thirds
scenes.image_prompt_2: a closed wooden stall door, a thin line of darkness beneath it, low angle, leading lines of floor tiles toward it

scenes.narration: That's the question at the center of Aka Manto, one of Japan's most unsettling urban legends.
scenes.image_prompt: Aka Manto in a crimson hooded cloak standing at the far end of a long tiled restroom, small and centered under one ceiling light
scenes.image_prompt_2: a single fluorescent tube flickering over a row of wooden stall doors, circular pool of light on the tiles

scenes.narration: The story goes that a mysterious figure wearing a red cloak and mask appears when someone is alone.
scenes.image_prompt: Aka Manto glimpsed through a half-open stall door, crimson cloak and smooth pale mask, frame within a frame
scenes.image_prompt_2: the edge of a crimson cloak trailing across wet floor tiles, close-up

scenes.narration: Choose red, and the legend says you'll be covered in blood. Choose blue, and you'll be drained of it.
scenes.image_prompt: a roll of red paper and a roll of blue paper on a dark tiled ledge, side by side, dramatic lamp light, no text
scenes.image_prompt_2: the student pressing her back to a stall wall, eyes wide, dark tiles, diagonal shadow across her

scenes.narration: But what if you try to outsmart him? In some versions, asking for yellow or another color brings an equally terrifying fate. And running away isn't always an option.
scenes.image_prompt: the student whispering toward the stall partition, hand on the cold wall, tense, medium shot
scenes.image_prompt_2: a restroom exit door at the end of a corridor of stalls, far away, deep shadows, leading lines

scenes.narration: There's only one way the legend says you might survive: refuse both choices and walk away without answering.
scenes.image_prompt: the student walking away down the tiled restroom toward a dim doorway, seen from behind, calm and silent
scenes.image_prompt_2: an empty restroom floor reflecting one cold light, footprints of water leading to the door

scenes.narration: Because Aka Manto isn't offering you toilet paper. He's making you choose how your story ends.
scenes.image_prompt: Aka Manto's smooth pale mask in the shadow of a crimson hood, close-up, eyes not visible
scenes.image_prompt_2: a gloved hand in a crimson sleeve resting on a stall door frame, close-up, diagonal composition

scenes.narration: So if you're ever alone and hear that question from the next stall... Don't pick a color.
scenes.image_prompt: a dark tiled restroom at night, every stall door closed, one fluorescent tube still on, wide shot
scenes.image_prompt_2: the closed stall door from scene one, centered, its gap beneath now completely black
